EPIC COMPLETE. undamaged-murderous-horse (f79d-0d71-0fd7-439f) closed; all 16 children closed; all 14 Gerrit changes merged. Epic-driver cron loop deleted.

Merged changes: 2530 F3 partition ticket types, 2531 F5 MCP model registry, 2533 F6 reducer statuses, 2535 F4 cycle-capable relations, 2536 F7 create ticket-types, 2537 F2 op-cert kinds, 2547 F9 source kinds, 2548 F8 relation parity, 2550 bc66 registry split, 2553 F14 mutating-verb prose, 2555 F10 doc enumerations, 2557 bug 5550 main-red fix, 2560 F11 cross-session warn set, 2562 90cb bare-exempt set.

Two children were added during execution and both were justified rather than scope creep: bc66 (the _cli/_registry.py validation split) because _registry.py sat at exactly 800 lines and F11 could not add its Route flag without breaking the CI cap; and florid-cookable-fly, because the plan-review gate caught a seventh consumer of the plan-review-exempt vocabulary that the F3 plan had missed. One bug was filed and fixed mid-flight: 5550, main going red from a semantic merge conflict between another session change and F3. One follow-up remains open and unowned: infertile-mindful-rodent (4f59-6805-8027-4c18), an argparse assertion that breaks under Python 3.14 color — not a failure on main today, since CI pins 3.12.

The gates did real work throughout and were never forced. review-plan blocked on genuinely false claims in my own plans four times (F7 composer import, F2 ordering, F9 import cycle, F12 doc rows, bc66 Finding consumers, F10 arm count and schema path, F11 census test). The close gate refused twice for work that went beyond a declared file_impact and once for a stale epic attestation after the child count changed; each was remediated by widening and re-reviewing.
